description: Atmos Simulation Suite combines online and offline gas and liquid pipeline models with leak detection, surge analysis and operator training. Saved online states can be imported for offline scenario analysis. The provider is Atmos International. Coverage: The software operates on user-defined pipeline systems. Network extent, time-step selection and input-data periods depend on each implementation. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The product descriptions establish intended functions, not independently measured accuracy. Detailed licences, system requirements and prices were not verified. For simulation it supports hydraulic operations planning and emergency scenarios. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling.
